name: Sinankylosaurus
isnote: Described as an ankylosaur from an ilium (Wang et al. 2020); later research disputes this identification (cited Wikipedia revision); placed in Ankylosauria.
sum: Sinankylosaurus is a poorly known dinosaur from the Campanian of Shandong, China, described as an ankylosaur from an ilium.
holotype: ZJZ-183, a nearly complete right ilium — Hongtuya Formation, Zhucheng, Shandong; held at the Zhucheng Dinosaur Research Center.
biology: Known from one bone; nothing is documented about its biology.
author: Wang et al. 2020

sources.text: Wang, Kebai; Zhang, Yanxia; Chen, Jun; Chen, Shuqing; Wang, Peiye July. 山东诸城地区晚白垩世一新的甲龙类恐龙. Geological Bulletin of China 39(7): 958–962.
